articles.title: 'Leader' Sainz commits to Williams with new deal
articles.description: Carlos Sainz signs a new contract to stay at the Williams team into 2027 and beyond.

articles.title: Hadjar to miss Dutch Grand Prix with wrist injury
articles.description: Red Bull's Isack Hadjar will miss this weekend's Dutch Grand Prix after injuring his wrist during the summer break.

articles.title: Antonelli - the boy 'born in a garage' who started driving on dad's lap
articles.description: Kimi Antonelli was a natural driver at the age of three, according to his dad. Here's how he went on to lead the F1 drivers' championship at the age of 19.

articles.title: Albon to stay with Williams for 2027 season
articles.description: Alex Albon will stay at Williams for the 2027 season after signing a one-year contract extension.

articles.title: Ukraine appeals to FIA to overturn Russia inclusion
articles.description: Ukraine's government appeals against FIA's decision to welcome back Russian and Belarussian drivers.
